* Please check the group announcement for more info about the future of this game. Thank you.

WARNING: This game may contain loud noises and sudden jumpscares.

Welcome to Piggy Roleplay PLUS! A role-playing game (Piggy RP) based off MiniToon's "Piggy" that aims to make the most favorable role-playing experience for people to enjoy.
While this game centers on the main Piggy story, it also has its own lore! You can follow it through the playable chapters, badge quests, or hidden notes in maps!

Please keep in mind this game is still in development. More morphs, maps, items, and features will be added in future updates.

Credits:

- MiniToon, WWS Team, Team i2R; Piggy Assets

Any other additional credits (like the music) may be found in-game.

Game released on 4/12/2026
